title: Ankle monitor puts Florida teen at the scene of a $210K Porsche theft, deputies say
comment: Deputies say a 19-year-old joined at least three others in taking a $210,000 Porsche Panamera, seven pairs of shoes included, from a mansion in Miami-Dade's Horse Country. The court-ordered GPS ankle monitor he was already wearing from an earlier police-chase case placed him at the scene.
excerpt: Florida Man's $210K Porsche Theft Allegedly Foiled By One Small Mistake: He Was Wearing A GPS Ankle Monitor BroBible
